title: gethealthendpointreturnsservicestatus
description: Verify GET /health returns 200 with database and Redis status up when services are healthy.

title: postapiv1authregisterwithvaliddata
description: Test user registration at POST /api/v1/auth/register with valid data returns 201 and created user data.

title: postapiv1authregisterwithduplicateemail
description: Test registering with an email that already exists returns a 409/400 conflict error rather than creating a duplicate account.

title: postapiv1authsigninwithvalidcredentials
description: Test POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in with valid credentials returns 200 with access and refresh tokens.

title: postapiv1authsigninwithinvalidcredentials
description: Test POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in with wrong password returns 401 unauthorized and does not leak whether the email exists.

title: postapiv1authrefreshwithvalidrefreshtoken
description: Test POST /api/v1/auth/refresh with a valid refresh token returns 200 with a new access token.

title: postapiv1authsignoutrevokessession
description: Test POST /api/v1/auth/sign-out with a valid access token returns 200 and subsequently invalidates the refresh token so it can no longer be used.

title: getapiv1authvalidatewithandwithoutjwt
description: Test GET /api/v1/auth/validate returns 200 for a valid access token and 401 when no/invalid token is supplied.

title: getapiv1usersmerequiresauth
description: Test GET /api/v1/users/me returns the authenticated user's profile with a valid token and 401 without a token.

title: patchapiv1usersmeupdatesprofile
description: Test PATCH /api/v1/users/me with valid fields updates and returns the profile, and rejects invalid payloads with 400.

title: postapiv1usersmepasswordwithwrongcurrentpassword
description: Test POST /api/v1/users/me/password with an incorrect current password is rejected (400/403) and does not change the password.

title: getapiv1academieslistscopedtoorg
description: Test GET /api/v1/academies returns only academies belonging to the authenticated user's organization, and 401 when unauthenticated.

title: postapiv1academiescreatesnewacademy
description: Test POST /api/v1/academies with valid data creates a new academy scoped to the caller's organization and returns 201.

title: getapiv1academiesbyidnotfoundforforeigntenant
description: Test GET /api/v1/academies/:id returns 404 (not leaking existence) when the academy belongs to a different organization than the caller.

title: getapiv1planslistsplancatalog
description: Test GET /api/v1/plans returns the subscription plan catalog for an authenticated caller.

title: getapiv1addonslistsaddoncatalog
description: Test GET /api/v1/add-ons returns the plan add-on catalog for an authenticated caller.

title: getapiv1coursesundernonexistentacademyreturns404
description: Test GET /api/v1/academies/:id/courses with a non-existent academy id returns 404.

title: getapiv1notificationsrequiresauth
description: Test GET /api/v1/notifications returns the authenticated user's notification feed and 401 without authentication.

title: getapiv1searchrequiresauthandvalidatesquery
description: Test GET /api/v1/search performs a tenant-scoped search for an authenticated user and returns 400 for a missing/empty query parameter.

title: postapiv1paymentswebhookrejectsunsignedpayload
description: Test the payment webhook endpoint rejects requests with a missing or invalid provider signature rather than processing them.
